property.name: note
property.value: Combat music for the boss. Controlled by the parameter BossStage, which goes from 0 to 3, and BossEntered, which goes from 0 to 1. BossEntered transitions to the more active music. Bosstage 1 fades in the arp and lead tracks. BossStage 2 transistion to the Stage 2 marker. BossStage 3 transitions to the Dead marker
